entries.title: Psalms 57:1
segments: ¶<To the chief music-maker; put to Al-tashheth. Michtam. Of David. When he went in flight from Saul, in the hole of the rock.> Have mercy on me, O God, have mercy on me; for the hope of my soul is in you: I will keep myself safely under the shade of your wings, till these troubles are past.

entries.title: Psalms 57:2
segments: I will send up my cry to the Most High God; to God who does all things for me.

entries.title: Psalms 57:3
segments: He will send from heaven, and take me from the power of him whose desire is for my destruction. God will send out his mercy and his good faith.

entries.title: Psalms 57:4
segments: My soul is among lions; I am stretched out among those who are on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and whose tongue is a sharp sword.

entries.title: Psalms 57:5
segments: O God, be lifted up higher than the heavens; let your glory be over all the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 57:6
segments: They have made ready a net for my steps; my soul is bent down; they have made a great hole before me, and have gone down into it themselves. (Selah.)

entries.title: Psalms 57:7
segments: ¶My heart is fixed, O God, my heart is fixed; I will make songs, and give praise.

entries.title: Psalms 57:8
segments: You are my glory; let the instruments of music be awake; I myself will be awake with the dawn.

entries.title: Psalms 57:9
segments: I will give you praise, O Lord, among the peoples; I will make songs to you among the nations.

entries.title: Psalms 57:10
segments: For your mercy is great, stretching up to the heavens, and your righteousness goes up to the clouds.

entries.title: Psalms 57:11
segments: Be lifted up, O God, higher than the heavens, let your glory be over all the earth.
